claims: The Artemis 2 mission is a crewed moon mission.
The Artemis 2 mission is scheduled to launch on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis 2 launch is scheduled for 6:24 p.m. EDT (2224 GMT).
The Artemis 2 launch is from Launch Pad 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis 2 mission carries four astronauts around the Moon.
The Artemis 2 mission duration is approximately 10 days.
The Artemis 2 mission has a two-hour launch window opening at 6:24 p.m.
The Artemis 2 launch window is 6:24 p.m. – 8:24 p.m. ET.
The official NASA YouTube channel will provide a live stream starting with fueling operations at 7:45 a.m. EDT.
As of March 31, 2026, there is an 80% chance of favorable conditions for the Artemis 2 launch.
Backup launch windows for Artemis 2 are available from April 2 through April 6.
